neighbours.label: one document replacing or adding to another (supersedes, superseded, supplemented by, replaces)
fire: This contract supersedes any earlier agreements.
The new treaty superseded the old borders of the kingdom.
The order was supplemented by a number of later rules.
A signed contract usually replaces the standard license.
The revised act supersedes all prior regulations.
Their manual was supplemented by a short online guide.
This edition supersedes the one printed last year.
quiet: This contract includes a list of earlier agreements.
The new treaty ended the old war of the kingdom.
The order was signed by a number of later guests.
A signed contract usually sits in the office drawer.
The revised act is about farm regulations.
Their manual was read by a short young clerk.
This edition costs less than the one printed last year.
